mapper.select: SELECT E.SETTLEMENT_ID, E.GROUP_ID, E.PAYER_ID, M.NAME AS PAYER_NAME, E.TITLE, E.EXPENSE_AMOUNT, E.PAYMENT_METHOD, E.CREATED_AT, E.UPDATED_AT, GROUP_CONCAT(PM.NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS PARTICIPANT_NAMES, COUNT(EP.MEMBER_ID) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT FROM EXPENSE_SETTLEMENT E JOIN MEMBER M ON E.PAYER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN EXPENSE_PARTICIPANT EP ON E.SETTLEMENT_ID = EP.SETTLEMENT_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER PM ON EP.MEMBER_ID = PM.MEMBER_ID WHERE E.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} GROUP BY E.SETTLEMENT_ID ORDER BY E.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXPENSE_SETTLEMENT ( GROUP_ID, PAYER_ID, TITLE, EXPENSE_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_METHOD, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{payerId}, #{title}, #{expenseAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO EXPENSE_PARTICIPANT (SETTLEMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, SPLIT_AMOUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES
(#{item.settlementId}, #{item.memberId}, #{item.splitAmount}, NOW(), NOW())
